observable.text: One consolidated notification entry: a single notification center, reachable from one consistent location, that aggregates notifications from every module under a SINGLE shared unread state (badge / count) kept in sync everywhere. Reading or clearing a notification updates the unified state. If module-level entries are kept, they must read from the same unread state instead of maintaining independent ones — so the badge can never disagree between surfaces. observable.phenomenon: At least three separate 🔔 entries exist, each with an independent unread state: (1) the profile page header, (2) the Artifacts page header, and (3) the CloudDoc / deliverable document header. A user must visit each module separately to check notifications, and the unread badges disagree between surfaces — e.g. on the Artifacts page the in-page bell reports unread while the left-sidebar Artifacts entry reports none (#2334).
